package probe

import "os/exec"

// cmd is a package variable a loop runs before this function binds it: source
// order and run order differ, so the binding is no command the check can
// follow.
var cmd *exec.Cmd

func loopBeforeBinding(rounds int) error {
	for i := 0; i < rounds; i++ {
		if i == 1 {
			if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	}

	cmd = exec.Command("sh")
	cmd.Env = []string{"PATH=/usr/bin"}

	return nil
}
